The lab can exercise it: the reverted node has pending upgrades (my clean-phase dist-upgrade simulation: 252 upgraded, 27 newly installed), so the list after the job can be required to be non-empty and each listed package to have an installed version below its candidate (or a package downgraded to its release-pocket version with a known High/Critical USN to appear on it). The list is also never fed from the job into apt-update-relevant.sh (that check writes the list by hand), so the job -> list -> install chain is untested end to end.
